title: Echoes of Angkor / ប្រវត្តិអង្គរ
theme: Rise of water management and great temples

dialogue.speaker: zhou
dialogue.text: In the heart of the great forest, stone temples rise to touch the clouds.
dialogue.subtitle: Stone temples rise in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: jaya
dialogue.text: We carve the baray so living waters sustain our people through every season.
dialogue.subtitle: Carving the baray for living waters.
